stories.headline: Friday's BTC ETF print flipped to a small inflow; Monday's flow is next before CPI
stories.blurb: US spot bitcoin ETFs completed Friday at about +$21M after losing ~$485M on Oct 7 and ~$244M on Oct 8 — the heaviest two-day stretch since June. No fresher complete session yet into this Monday rebuild. — The week was defined by institutional redemptions; Friday's small green print broke the streak and makes Monday's flow the next tell before Wednesday's CPI.

stories.headline: Macro calendar: September CPI on Oct 14, then the Oct 27–28 FOMC
stories.blurb: Markets head into the week watching Wednesday's inflation print and the late-October Fed meeting, after September's hike and hawkish minutes helped reset rate expectations. — A hot CPI could revive hike bets and keep pressure on risk assets; a cooler print would ease the liquidity headwind that weighed on ETF demand last week.
